note: Franky's notebook. Written by the duck itself (the model's weights never change). tries = attempts the note was shown in, wins = how many of those succeeded.

knowledge.text: Pickup requires the banana to be within 0.10 m of the beak tip.
The safety system refuses movement if the rim of a box would trip me.
Small turns (e.g., 10 degrees) may not execute precisely or may be ineffective.

skills.text: Use find() repeatedly to confirm the target's relative position before attempting movement or pickup.
